mapper.select: SELECT s.ITEM_SHARE_ID, s.ITEM_ID, s.USERNAME, s.SHARE_TYPE, s.PERMISSION, s.ASSIGNED_BY, s.ASSIGNED_AT, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, s.UPDATED_AT, s.UPDATED_BY, u.USERNAME, u.NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ab.NAME AS ASSIGNED_BY_NAME FROM TB_ITEM_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON s.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER ab ON s.ASSIGNED_BY = ab.USERNAME WHERE s.ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.ITEM_SHARE_ID, s.ITEM_ID, s.USERNAME, s.SHARE_TYPE, s.PERMISSION, s.ASSIGNED_BY, s.ASSIGNED_AT, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, i.CONTENT, ab.NAME AS ASSIGNED_BY_NAME FROM TB_ITEM_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_ITEM i ON s.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ab ON s.ASSIGNED_BY = ab.USERNAME WHERE s.USERNAME = #{username} AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED') ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.ITEM_SHARE_ID, s.ITEM_ID, s.USERNAME, s.SHARE_TYPE, s.PERMISSION, s.ASSIGNED_BY, s.ASSIGNED_AT, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, s.UPDATED_AT, s.UPDATED_BY, u.USERNAME, u.NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ab.NAME AS ASSIGNED_BY_NAME FROM TB_ITEM_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON s.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER ab ON s.ASSIGNED_BY = ab.USERNAME WHERE s.ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND s.USERNAME = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITEM_SHARE ( ITEM_ID, USERNAME, SHARE_TYPE, PERMISSION, ASSIGNED_BY, ASSIGNED_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{username}, #{shareType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{permission}, #{assignedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assignedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
